title: feat(nm2frmrdfx): neighbor-read of cyclic-frame transport at t+1 on three-axis far-face opposite x-probes: reverse fails, face fails
science: Far-face three-axis x-probes: M(A)=M(D)={+e_3,-e_3}, a non-singleton incoming set, so unique signed m fails. Third distinct split-failure mechanism in the band (mixed M), alongside missing-axis cover fail and axis-overlap cover fail.
